title: EFFECTIVENESS OF DEBIASING TECHNIQUES: AN INDIGENOUS QUALITATIVE ANALYSIS

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative analysis of model-generated text continuations using prompts that substitute indigenous (Māori) versus white (Kiwi/Pākehā) descriptors, and outlining the use of the Sentence Encoder Association Test (SEAT) with newly curated, New Zealand-specific target and attribute word sets.
